style: Elegant flat vector illustration in deep indigo (#1d1f3b), warm gold (#ffcc4d) and white, clean shapes, no text.

subjects.mecanique-generale: An open car engine bay seen from above with a completely plain, smooth engine cover (absolutely no emblem, no badge, no letter, no symbol anywhere); a hand-held diagnostic scanner lies on the fender, plugged in by its cable, a combination wrench beside it. No hands, no people.

hero: A spacious repair shop interior: a car on a lift, a gold tool chest, a large round wall clock without numbers, warm pendant lights. All cars are generic invented designs: no recognizable real models, no brand grilles, no badges or emblems. Flat vector, DARK indigo overall, gold highlights, white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no numbers.
